items.title: First annual premium collected by direct debit
items.quote: Den ersten Jahresbeitrag ziehen wir zum Versicherungsbeginn per Lastschrift ein.
items.computation: Versicherungsbeginn is stated in the contract data table as '01.02.2027, 0:00 Uhr'. The first annual premium is withdrawn on that date. 2027-02-01 is a Monday, so no weekend shift is needed.

warnings: The contract's current term runs from 01.02.2027 to 31.01.2028 (one year, then auto-renews); the cancellation deadline 'spätestens drei Monate vor Ablauf des Versicherungsjahres' in Textform falls on 2027-10-31, a Sunday — a letter-form notice should be sent several business days earlier (e.g. by late October 2027) to be safely received by then, since notice deadlines are not automatically shifted to the next business day.

The policy has a 3-month waiting period (Wartezeit) for most coverage (not for Verkehrsrechtsschutz) starting from the Versicherungsbeginn on 01.02.2027, meaning claims under the waiting-period coverage are not valid until roughly 01.05.2027.
A per-claim deductible (Selbstbeteiligung) of 150 € applies to each Rechtsschutzfall.
